missing.title: This plugin needs DSH's official computer-control plugin to work
body: It looks like DSH's official computer-control plugin is not installed (or not enabled).

This plugin is only the display of that channel: the on-screen banner and the Esc interrupt are driven by it. Without it this plugin cannot do anything at all - not "a little less", but nothing to show.
After the install, DSH has to be restarted once for it to take effect.
missing.declined: Skipped. This plugin is unavailable for now; it will ask again on the next start.

disabled.title: The official computer-control plugin is installed, but not enabled
disabled.body: It sits in the plugin list as "disabled", so the official tools do not appear - and neither does the takeover banner.
disabled.note: This plugin stays unavailable until you enable it.
disabled.hint: (Enable it in the plugin list of the settings page; this button does the same thing.)

inactive.title: The official computer-control plugin is installed, but its tools did not appear
inactive.body: Both official rows are there and both are enabled, but the official tools (cua_driver_native__*) were not registered.
inactive.note: A version mismatch is the usual reason. Restarting the host usually fixes it.
inactive.noAutorestart: There is no auto-restart plugin on this machine, so the restart is yours to do.

text.restartHint: DSH has to be restarted once for it to take effect.

install.done: It is installed - DSH has to be restarted once for it to take effect.
install.partial: Partly installed: the two official plugin rows are not both in place yet; look again after the restart.
